chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q3 Two Stimuli (7 points) — Set 1: culture & agriculture (maps)
chunks.content: AP Human Geography FRQ 3 (Two Stimuli, here maps of agricultural production), 7 points, parts A–G, one each, escalating skill. Set 1 answer key by part: A [1] identify an example of a culture trait; B [1] describe the spatial pattern of cow's milk production in Africa shown in Map 1; C [1] explain how the globalization of agriculture may affect local culture traits; D [1] explain why regions of agricultural production may become interdependent; later parts continue with explain-level tasks. Common failure: describing a spatial pattern as a single location rather than a distribution (B); explain answers that lack a how/why mechanism.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3A, 7/7
chunks.content: Q3 (Set 1) scored 7/7 — identified a culture trait, described the map's spatial pattern of milk production, and explained agricultural globalization's cultural effects and regional interdependence. Full-credit model for the two-stimulus FRQ.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3B, 5/7
chunks.content: Q3 (Set 1) scored 5/7 — earned the identify/describe parts and some explain parts, losing about two explain-level points (mechanism-level cultural or interdependence explanations). Illustrates a solid response short on higher-order explanation.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3C, 2/7
chunks.content: Q3 (Set 1) scored 2/7 — earned only about two lower-skill parts (identify/describe), losing the explain-level parts. Illustrates a low response that reads the maps but cannot explain cultural or economic mechanisms.
